sources.snippet: AgriVision Pro: Edge-Optimized AI for Real-Time Crop Disease Diagnostics 🌾 AgriVision Pro is an AI-powered crop disease detection system designed to help users identify plant diseases from leaf images in real time. The project combines deep learning, TensorFlow Lite optimization, and a modern FastAPI-based web application to make crop health diagnosis faster, simpler, and more accessible.
